[contact omitted] Catherine Truszkowski

To:

Monday, July 26, 2021 at 1:05:03 PM Eastern Daylight Time
[contact omitted] Erin J Clancy, [contact omitted] USAID Libya Desk, [contact omitted] Allison Noble,
Hello Erin,
I am adding the Libya desk to the email so they can be a part of the rescheduling conversation.
Thank you,
Cate
On Mon, Jul 26, 2021 at 11:47 AM Catherine Truszkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hello Erin,
I hope you are well. Unfortunately, tomorrow's meeting will need to be rescheduled as Sylvia, one of the Libya Desk
Officers, cannot attend the meeting. Would Friday, July 30th, at 9:30 am or 10 am work for you?
Thank you,
Catherine
On Mon, Jul 26, 2021 at 9:05 AM Catherine Truszkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Good morning Erin,
I hope you had a great weekend. Great! I will add a calendar hold for tomorrow, Tuesday, the 27th, at 9:30 am EST.
Yes, that would be great. I will keep an eye out for your email with the zoom link.
Thank you,
Cate
On Fri, Jul 23, 2021 at 6:34 PM Erin J Clancy <
Hi Cate,
[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks for your patience. It looks like I can get a group together on Tuesday morning at 09:30am. I'm
assuming that's east coast time. Shall I send you a Zoom link?
Thanks,
Erin
From: Catherine Truszkowski <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, July 22, 2021 6:30 AM
To: Erin J Clancy <
[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Libya!
Good morning Erin,
Happy Thursday! I am following up in regards to scheduling the meeting with you. Megan would prefer to have the
meeting in the morning. She is available the following mornings:
Tuesday, July 27th, at 9:30 am and 10:30 am
Wednesday, July 28th, at 10:30 am
Friday, July 30th, at 9:30 am and 10:00 am
Would one of these times work for you?
Thank you,
Cate
On Thu, Jul 15, 2021 at 12:32 PM Erin J Clancy <
Hi Cate,
[contact omitted]> wrote:

I'm will take these times back to my team some of whom are in Europe/Dubai and will get back to you ASAP.
Thanks,
Erin
Sent from my iPhone
On Jul 15, 2021, at 9:29 AM, Catherine Truszkowski <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Erin,
I hope you are well. Megan is available to meet on Wednesday, July 21st, at 11:00 AM, Thursday,
July 22nd, at 11:30 am and 3:00pm, and Friday, July 23rd, at 11:00 am. Would one of these times
work for you?
Thank you,
Cate
On Thu, Jul 15, 2021 at 12:21 PM Megan Doherty <[contact omitted]> wrote:
I do! Adding in Cate here to help for my schedule and also bring in our Libya Desk.
On Thu, Jul 15, 2021 at 12:19 PM Erin J Clancy <
[contact omitted]> wrote:
You're too kind. I flagged your email to a few folks and it's generating interest from a few other
teams. Do you have a scheduler I could work with for availability? Think it would be most
helpful to you to hear from the smaller group it not sure I can get all of them together on
Tuesday.
Sent from my iPhone
On Jul 15, 2021, at 5:59 AM, Megan Doherty <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Aw you should have just let me write it - 100% across the board! Tues July 20 is
great - would 2pm EST work for you?
On Wed, Jul 14, 2021 at 8:06 PM Erin J Clancy <
Hi there,
[contact omitted]> wrote:
The company's deadline for our performance evaluations were do 2
minutes ago, so this is exactly the time when I was going to finally be
able to reply. Would next Tuesday, July 20, work to discuss?
Looking forward to the conversation.
Erin
From: Megan Doherty <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, July 14, 2021 3:46 PM
To: Erin J Clancy <
[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Libya!
Heya! Checking in to see if you might have time to connect in the next week

On Wed, Jun 30, 2021 at 6:38 PM Megan Doherty <[contact omitted]>
wrote:
Hello!
Delighted to have An Actual Work Reason to talk to you! As mentioned, we
are anticipating elections in Libya on December 24 this year. There is
already a dangerous uptick in electoral disinformation and hate speech,
including calls to attack the election commission and outright falsehoods
about the process.
We are doing a lot of work with Libyan civil society and the election
commission on this front. As you may be aware, Libyans rely on Facebook
for... literally everything and this is their main platform for spreading hate
speech and disinformation. Id love to share with you a little bit more about
what we're doing and also chat with you about how either USAID or our
partners can engage with Facebook on electoral violence prevention.
Let me know when you're around to connect. I'm out of town for the 4th,
but otherwise around until I turn into a pumpkin in August.
Best,
Megan
